n_people = len(roommates_list) + 1

dinner_total = Decimal('122')
share_taxi = (taxi_total / Decimal(n_people)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
share_dinner = (dinner_total / Decimal(n_people)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

print('n_people', n_people)

# Map contacts by first name
nancy_contact = next(c for c in roommates_list if c.get('first_name')=='Nancy' and c.get('last_name')=='Ritter')

# Create payment requests for taxi to each roommate (including Nancy)
